input_unit: one target API bundle containing an API Profile, compact views of available Helper Profiles, and deterministically supplied eligible API-specific Knowledge records

target_property_parameter_contracts.subject_refs: Use exact API Profile parameter_id or return_id values, or one of context.backend, context.device, context.autograd, context.execution, and context.resource.
target_property_parameter_contracts.property_refs: Use normalized lowercase semantic paths with one or more dot-separated segments; a canonical single-segment property such as dtype is valid. Do not emit C++ expressions, method calls, generated variable names, or Helper identifiers.

builder_materialization.knowledge_decision.knowledge_id: Replace with the exact Knowledge Reference from the supplied eligible Knowledge set.
builder_materialization.source_ref: Use only the exact supplied API Profile profile_id or eligible Knowledge knowledge_id as source_id; never use nested evidence_id values. The Builder attaches source version and content hash.
builder_materialization.exploration_plan.default_branch_id: Set to the branch_id of the unique branch whose branch_kind is default.
builder_materialization.exploration_plan.budget_policy_ref: Set to null for controlled_baseline or to the exact versioned budget-policy artifact used for bug-aware allocation.
builder_materialization.exploration_plan.branches[].budget_share: Assign deterministically from the referenced budget policy and normalize all branch shares to 1.
builder_materialization.local_identifiers: Normalize identifier prefixes and numbering and rewrite internal references. LLM synthesis handles initial records only; feedback-derived budget revisions use the Builder's deterministic feedback path.

placeholder_policy.null_placeholders: Null values in templates are not default decisions. Replace them unless the final HarnessSpec Schema permits null.
placeholder_policy.empty_arrays: Use an empty array only when the corresponding cardinality and structural constraints allow it.
placeholder_policy.placeholder_objects: Do not copy unpopulated template objects into the response.

output_constraints: Return only fields shown by response_template and item_templates.
Use only supplied eligible Knowledge IDs and supplied source IDs.
Every required local identifier and human-readable summary must be non-empty.

A Target Property semantic requirement may use only a requirement_type defined in target_property_parameter_contracts; result_equivalence, no_crash, and other Oracle expectations belong under oracle_requirement.expected_behavior.
oracle_requirement.oracle_type must use the oracle_type vocabulary; no_crash and other expected outcomes are requirement_type values, not Oracle types.
Every semantic source_ref.source_id must be an exact supplied API Profile profile_id or eligible Knowledge knowledge_id, never an internal evidence_id.
Exactly one branch with branch_kind default must exist; the Builder derives default_branch_id from it.
Do not emit budget_policy_ref or budget_share; the Builder assigns the policy reference and positive shares deterministically.
A historical input, output, relation, or context state deliberately generated or explored by a Knowledge-directed branch must be a Target Property, not solely a Branch Precondition.

A selected Knowledge may omit a Target Property only when its contribution is solely Oracle- or behavior-directed; in that case add oracle_only_contribution to its reason_codes and cite it from a supported Oracle.
Target Property risk dimensions must be included in the containing branch risk dimensions.
Each Activation Target observes exactly one Target Property; state transitions use one before and one after point, and other requirement types use one evaluate point.
Target-API invocation is a fixed downstream execution invariant and must not be emitted as an Activation Target.

Every Oracle observation_subjects array must be non-empty and contain only exact API Profile parameter_id or return_id values, or context.backend, context.device, context.autograd, context.execution, or context.resource.
Semantic source references may identify only the supplied API Profile or selected Knowledge; Helper Profiles are capability context, not semantic evidence.
Do not include full source records, source code, Helper calls, Strategy Primitives, or hidden reasoning.
Cross-field and reference invariants not listed here are enforced by the Validator against the final HarnessSpec Schema.
